'''Alandra Mipsy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] reporter for the [[Colonial News Nets]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Mipsy covered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia's]] political and celebrity scene, and as such was often invited to exclusive parties held by influential [[Tapani Noble Houses|nobles]], several of whom she was on friendly terms with. The reporter sympathized with the Alliance during the war, and aided Rebel cells in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], using her position to sneak cell members into exclusive events while they were disguised as her film crew.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alandra Mipsy first appeared as a possible ally for Rebel heroes in the campaign guide included in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The supplement was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and did not clarify Mipsy's [[Species/Legends|species]].
